requirement: content.replace edits module words on a Joomla site Apply wrote in another language, and on every CMS a writable stored place that holds the words is named instead of "do not look for another way in"

oracle.ref: PR #1403 (fix); fix evidence: 16/10/2026 local stand (develop b472e98a1), Dutch Tracy Business site deschaar1610: content.replace refused "Elena Gurova · IR Director" (module-860) as words the template prints; the turn took 58 s and 8 steps before content.contract apply wrote it
oracle.invariant: S1: the call writes, with module-441.1 in the one apply. S2: the first call is NOT_EDITABLE whose next is not "do not look for another way in" and whose held lists module-441.1; the at: call writes it. S3: NOT_EDITABLE with held [{at, label}] and a next that carries at:["<that place>"]; a place with writable:false keeps the plain next. S4: the first answer's stopped says part of the site is unsearched and never "search a longer phrase"; the second still says "search a longer phrase". S5: NOT_EDITABLE with held [{at, label}] and a next naming at:["<that value>"]; the unwritable value keeps the plain next ("that is an answer"). WordPress and sealed Joomla reach the core check of S3; open Joomla never answers that next.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
